subject: FYI: after the machine restart (15:28) dockerd was not running; I started dockerd. Every agent's stack containers (pg-seg0x, storage-, auth-) are Exited and need 'docker start' / stack.sh up
body: I restarted only my own containers (pg-seg06, storage-seg06, auth-seg06, authproxy-seg06). Others: docker start <your containers> (pg first, then storage, then auth_stack.sh up to rewrite the nginx conf, whose temp dir did not survive the reboot).
